subject: Chemistry
title: Hydrocarbons
summary: Alkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, sp³) kaafi unreactive hain aur free-radical substitution karte hain. Unke conformations (ethane ka staggered vs eclipsed) energy mein alag hain.

Alkenes (CₙH₂ₙ, C=C) aur alkynes (CₙH₂ₙ₋₂, C≡C) electrophilic addition karte hain. HX Markovnikov rule se judta hai, sirf peroxide ke saath HBr ulta (anti-Markovnikov). Alkenes geometrical isomerism dikhate hain.
Terminal alkynes thode acidic hain (sp carbon) aur acetylides banate hain. Ozonolysis batata hai double bond kahan tha.

Benzene aromatic hai (planar, cyclic, 6 π electrons — Hückel 4n + 2). Ye electrophilic substitution pasand karta hai, aur substituents aane wale group ko ortho/para ya meta par bhejte hain (directive influence).

formulas.name: Wurtz reaction
formulas.mistake: Do alag alkyl halides se mixture banta hai; methane nahi ban sakta — bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Free-radical halogenation
formulas.formula: CH₄ + Cl₂ (hν) → CH₃Cl + HCl (initiation, propagation, termination)
formulas.mistake: Halogens ki reactivity: F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂; 3° H sabse jaldi badalta hai — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Markovnikov addition
formulas.mistake: H us carbon par jaata hai jismein pehle se zyada H hai (zyada stable carbocation) — ulta mat karo.

formulas.name: Peroxide (Kharasch) effect
formulas.mistake: Sirf HBr ke saath — HCl ya HI ke saath nahi.

formulas.name: Ozonolysis
formulas.formula: R₂C=CR′₂ + O₃ then Zn/H₂O → R₂C=O + O=CR′₂

formulas.name: Hydrogenation of alkynes
formulas.formula: Lindlar's catalyst (Pd/CaCO₃, quinoline) → cis-alkene;  Na in liquid NH₃ → trans-alkene

formulas.name: Hydration of alkynes
formulas.formula: HC≡CH + H₂O (HgSO₄, dil. H₂SO₄) → CH₃CHO;  other alkynes → ketones

formulas.name: Acidity of hydrocarbons
formulas.when: Terminal alkynes Na, NaNH₂ aur ammoniacal AgNO₃ se kyun react karte hain.

formulas.name: Aromaticity (Hückel rule)
formulas.formula: planar + cyclic + fully conjugated + (4n + 2) π electrons
formulas.mistake: Cyclopentadienyl anion (6π) aromatic hai; cation (4π) nahi — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Electrophilic substitution of benzene
formulas.formula: nitration (HNO₃/H₂SO₄, NO₂⁺);  halogenation (X₂/FeX₃);  sulphonation (fuming H₂SO₄);  Friedel–Crafts alkylation (RX/AlCl₃) and acylation (RCOCl/AlCl₃)
formulas.note: Strongly deactivated rings par Friedel–Crafts nahi hota: nitrobenzene alkylation/acylation NAHI deta (ise FC reactions ke solvent ki tarah bhi use karte hain); aniline bhi fail (–NH₂ AlCl₃ se bandh jaata hai).

formulas.name: Directive influence
formulas.formula: o/p-directing activating: –OH, –NH₂, –OR, –CH₃;  o/p-directing deactivating: halogens;  m-directing deactivating: –NO₂, –CN, –CHO, –COOH, –SO₃H
formulas.when: Agla group kahan jaayega, predict karna.
formulas.mistake: Halogens alag case hain: deactivating (−I) phir bhi ortho/para-directing (+R) — galat mat samjho.

examples.title: Ozonolysis product
examples.solution: CH₃CH=CHCH₃ double bond par toot-ta hai → 2 CH₃CHO (ethanal).

examples.title: Markovnikov vs peroxide
examples.problem: Propene + HBr, benzoyl peroxide ke saath aur bina?
examples.solution: Bina peroxide: 2-bromopropane (Markovnikov, 2° carbocation se). Peroxide ke saath: 1-bromopropane (free-radical, anti-Markovnikov).

examples.title: cis ya trans
examples.problem: But-2-yne ko H₂/Lindlar's catalyst se aur alag se Na/liq. NH₃ se reduce kiya. Products?

examples.title: Aromatic hai ya nahi?
examples.problem: Kaun aromatic: benzene, cyclooctatetraene, cyclopentadienyl anion, cyclobutadiene?
examples.solution: Benzene (6π) aur cyclopentadienyl anion (6π) 4n + 2 follow karte hain. Cyclooctatetraene (8π, non-planar) aur cyclobutadiene (4π, antiaromatic) nahi.

examples.title: Toluene ka nitration
examples.problem: Toluene ke nitration ke main products?
examples.solution: –CH₃ activating aur o/p-directing → o-nitrotoluene aur p-nitrotoluene (kam crowding se p major).

examples.title: Friedel–Crafts acylation
examples.problem: Benzene + CH₃COCl, anhydrous AlCl₃ ke saath?
examples.solution: Acetophenone (C₆H₅COCH₃). Acylium ion CH₃C≡O⁺ electrophile hai; alkylation ke ulta yahan rearrangement aur polysubstitution nahi.

topics.title: Conformations of ethane
topics.explain: C–C single bond par ghoomne se staggered (sabse stable, minimum torsional strain) aur eclipsed (sabse kam stable) conformations; energy difference sirf ~12.5 kJ/mol, isliye tezi se badalte rehte hain. Newman aur sawhorse projections se dikhaate hain.

topics.title: Geometrical isomerism
topics.explain: C=C par restricted rotation se cis aur trans isomers, jab har double-bonded carbon par do alag groups hon. cis-But-2-ene ka boiling point zyada (polar); trans ka melting point zyada (achhe se pack hota hai).

topics.title: Preparation of alkenes
topics.explain: Alcohols ka dehydration (conc. H₂SO₄, garam), alkyl halides ka dehydrohalogenation (alcoholic KOH — Saytzeff product, zyada substituted alkene, major), aur alkynes ka partial reduction.

topics.title: Reactions of alkenes
topics.explain: H₂, X₂ (bromine water decolourise — unsaturation ka test), HX, H₂O (acid-catalysed) ka addition; thande dilute alkaline KMnO₄ (Baeyer's reagent, diol; purple rang ud jaata hai) se oxidation; ozonolysis; polymerisation (polythene).

topics.title: Alkynes
topics.explain: Calcium carbide se (CaC₂ + 2H₂O → C₂H₂ + Ca(OH)₂) ya double dehydrohalogenation se. Terminal alkynes ammoniacal AgNO₃ ke saath safed precipitate dete hain — alkenes se alag karne ka test. Red-hot iron tube mein ethyne polymerise hokar benzene banata hai.

topics.title: Benzene structure
topics.explain: Kekulé structures resonance forms hain; saare C–C bonds barabar (139 pm, single aur double ke beech). Benzene addition se bachta hai kyunki usse aromatic stability kho jaayegi.

topics.title: Carcinogenicity and toxicity
topics.explain: Kai polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (koyla, tobacco ke adhoore jalne se) carcinogenic hain, jaise 1,2-benzanthracene.

ratta: Markovnikov: H to carbon with more H;  peroxide effect only with HBr.
Nitrobenzene: Friedel–Crafts nahi (FC solvent ki tarah use).
